class.description: Penalises sampled (vx, wz) whose inner wheel sits under the drive's wheel-speed floor while turning (Airseekers Tron: 0.06 m/s, track 0.40 m).
Nav2 PathAlignCritic scored at a control point control_point_x ahead of base_link (heading damping for the lagging drive / GNSS fix; 0 = PathAlignCritic).
Row entry speed hold: forward speed capped at entry_speed until the heading is within heading_tol of a new straight row, then ramped up (2026-11-12).
